title: Salesforce Developer
summary: Salesforce developers customise and extend Salesforce, the customer management platform many sales and service teams use, with code (Apex and Lightning components) and low-code automation (Flows). They work with admins, business analysts and testers, often in IT services firms or in a company's CRM team.
dailyDuties: Write Apex classes and triggers for business rules
Build Lightning Web Components for custom screens
Automate a process with a Flow
Integrate Salesforce with another system through APIs
Write Apex test classes and deploy changes between orgs
Clarify requirements with admins and business users

skills.expectation: Write bulk-safe Apex classes, triggers and SOQL that stay within governor limits
Build Lightning Web Components for custom screens
Automate processes with Flows and know when code is the better choice
Write the JavaScript behind Lightning components
Integrate Salesforce with other systems over REST or SOAP APIs
Keep metadata in Git and deploy through a shared process
Turn business requests into clear stories and explain trade-offs to admins and users
Know the data model of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud or Experience Cloud
Deploy with Salesforce DX and a release tool such as Copado or Gearset
Write Apex test classes with meaningful assertions
Work in sprints with admins, testers and business analysts
Style components to match the Lightning design system
